mission: Adversarially critique Context Fabric v1 against current IR/database/software-engineering practice, identify simpler/faster routes and authority/currentness hazards, and produce a revised staged implementation and falsification plan.

source_freshness.note: Final prewrite reopened EPOCH, compiled packet, convergence, own claim and own run. No blocking convergence event affecting the isolated return scope was found.

critic_verdict.summary: Keep Git canonical truth, L0/L1/L2 progressive disclosure, explicit authority/lineage relationships and durable context receipts. Change the implementation order: do not make embeddings/vector search, generated prose digests or a broad knowledge-graph ontology prerequisites. The fastest falsifiable Context Fabric is deterministic repository-first: authority resolver + artifact inventory + exact identifiers/metadata + lexical retrieval + sparse explicit reference graph + hard constraint closure + context compiler/receipt. Add Postgres/FTS, embeddings and generated summaries only when measured retrieval or latency failures justify them.
critic_verdict.route_change: Replace 'four coordinated layers all required' with a capability ladder where semantic/vector and generated-summary layers are optional accelerators gated by benchmark evidence.

what_survives_attack.component: Git as canonical auditable source; indexes are disposable
what_survives_attack.reason: Correct authority boundary and best fit with current Prometeo runtime.
Useful context-budget abstraction, but L1 should initially be deterministic manifests/metadata rather than generated prose summaries.
These relationships are safety-critical, but the first graph should derive only from explicit durable identifiers/refs instead of attempting broad semantic knowledge extraction.
This is the operational capability being sought; it should be built before optional vector/database infrastructure.
Similarity is unsuitable for authority resolution.

main_attacks.target: Hybrid retrieval index as a mandatory architecture layer and implementation step 4 before the Context Compiler
main_attacks.finding: Embeddings are being committed to before Prometeo has evidence that exact IDs + structured metadata + lexical retrieval + explicit graph closure cannot recover the required sources. Current live Supabase has pg_cron and pg_net enabled but not vector or pg_trgm, so vector-first adds deployment/model/index/versioning work rather than reusing an existing Context Fabric substrate.
main_attacks.change: Make semantic/vector retrieval an optional fallback capability with a benchmark promotion gate. P1 must work with zero embedding service.

main_attacks.target: Automatic map-reduce prose compaction source chunks -> artifact summary -> domain digest -> root digest -> global kernel
main_attacks.finding: A multi-level generated-summary chain creates lossy transitive omission risk and broad invalidation churn. A missing incident/authority qualifier at the artifact-summary level can disappear from every higher layer while each layer still carries hashes.
main_attacks.change: Generate deterministic structural manifests first. Generated prose summaries are non-authoritative caches and may never be the only route to mandatory authority/negative-knowledge/contradiction evidence.

main_attacks.target: Conceptual utility = relevance + authority_need + dependency_need + contradiction_need + freshness + evidence_need - token_cost - redundancy
main_attacks.finding: Authority, privacy, freshness and contradiction obligations are not ordinary score terms. A weighted objective can conceptually trade away a mandatory artifact for token cost even though prose later says never to compress it away.
main_attacks.change: Split hard constraints from ranking. First construct mandatory closure M; only rank/prune optional evidence O. Token cost may optimize O but cannot remove M.

main_attacks.finding: For Current/owner/contract evidence, freshness is a validation condition tied to exact source identity, not a relevance bonus. A stale artifact cannot become acceptable merely because other score dimensions are strong.
main_attacks.change: Fail/rebuild on source-head/hash mismatch for freshness-critical inputs. Use recency only for optional discovery after authority resolution.

main_attacks.target: broad typed knowledge graph of many entity/edge classes
main_attacks.finding: A rich ontology invites entity-resolution ambiguity, inferred-edge errors and graph expansion that can itself recreate repository-scale context. The current durable schemas already expose exact project/chat/workstream/opportunity/run/claim/return/ref fields.
main_attacks.change: Start with a sparse explicit reference graph. Unresolved refs remain warnings. Semantic/inferred edges require separate provenance and must never carry authority.

main_attacks.target: prototype path-hash artifact identity for all files
main_attacks.finding: A path-derived id is deterministic but not durable across rename. RENAMED_FROM preserves history but forces identity churn even when an artifact has an explicit durable schema id.
main_attacks.change: Prefer explicit durable identity from source schemas when available; use path-derived fallback identity only for untyped artifacts and preserve rename lineage.

main_attacks.finding: pgvector documents that filtering with approximate HNSW/IVFFlat can reduce returned matches because filtering occurs after the approximate index scan unless iterative scans/partitioning are configured. This is especially dangerous if project/privacy/authority filters are assumed to preserve recall.
main_attacks.change: If vectors are later enabled, benchmark exact vs ANN recall, partition or preconstrain sensitive/root scopes where appropriate, record ANN parameters, and never use ANN as the only path for mandatory sources.

main_attacks.finding: The architecture does not make embedding model/version/chunker policy part of index validity. Semantic results can silently change after model/chunking updates even with unchanged source hashes.
main_attacks.change: Vector cache key must include content_hash + chunker_version + embedding_provider/model/dimensions + normalization policy. Model change invalidates/rebuilds semantic projection.

main_attacks.target: one derived index service across multiple roots/privacy classes
main_attacks.finding: Root/privacy hard filters must precede context exposure. Shared ANN structures also complicate recall/isolation; pgvector itself notes multitenant sharing can affect recall/speed and suggests partitioning/separate tables as an isolation option.
main_attacks.change: P1 stays repository/public-scope deterministic. Any later DB/vector service must encode privacy/root policy in the storage/query boundary, not only final reranking.

main_attacks.target: generic hybrid score combining lexical, semantic, graph, recency and authority weighting
main_attacks.finding: Without an explicit staged query plan, retrieval errors are hard to falsify and receipts cannot explain which mechanism selected each artifact.
main_attacks.change: Compiler uses deterministic stages with per-item selection_reason and stage provenance. Semantic fallback is explicit, not blended invisibly.

main_attacks.finding: Prometeo contains exact codes/paths/schema ids plus Spanish and English prose. Language stemmers or semantic retrieval can damage exact-code behavior if used before exact/normalized token matching.
main_attacks.change: Exact ids/paths/codes first; lexical layer preserves raw normalized tokens and can add language-aware FTS later as a secondary candidate source.

main_attacks.finding: A receipt can prove what was selected while still hiding why a critical artifact was absent from the candidate set.
main_attacks.change: Receipt records query-plan version, candidate counts per stage, mandatory closure, selected refs, high-ranked omitted refs/reasons, freshness identities and fallback use.

current_practice_evidence.finding: PostgreSQL provides deterministic lexical parsing/ranking primitives (tsvector/tsquery, ts_rank/ts_rank_cd); relevance remains application-specific. This is enough to support a lexical stage without requiring vectors.

Exact vector search provides perfect recall; approximate HNSW/IVFFlat trade recall for speed. Approximate filters can return too few matches unless iterative scans/partitioning/tuning are used, so ANN must be benchmarked and cannot own mandatory retrieval.

Hybrid FTS + semantic search and Reciprocal Rank Fusion are established implementation options once both retrieval channels are justified; they are not evidence that both channels are required for a small repository-first P1.

current_practice_evidence.source: live connected Supabase project read-only inspection
current_practice_evidence.finding: pg_cron 1.6.4 and pg_net 0.20.4 are enabled; vector and pg_trgm were not present in pg_extension at inspection time. No Prometeo Context-Fabric-specific public table was found by context/artifact/edge/digest name patterns.

current_practice_evidence.source: independent O-CONTEXT-INVENTORY-PROTOTYPE-V1 return inspected only after the initial critique was formed
current_practice_evidence.finding: An independent builder converged on A_REPOSITORY_FIRST_DETERMINISTIC and deferred Supabase/embeddings until after a deterministic canary. This independently corroborates, rather than causes, the critic route.

revised_candidate_architecture.name: Context Fabric Lite -> Evidence-Gated Hybrid
revised_candidate_architecture.principle: Correctness path is deterministic and works without embeddings, generated prose summaries or database availability. Optional accelerators must prove marginal value on a mission benchmark before entering the normal path.

core_primitives.name: Authority Resolver
core_primitives.job: Resolve exact root/project, owner, Current/Human Accepted/Served pointers, governing contracts and privacy class before retrieval ranking. Output is hard constraints, not scores.

core_primitives.name: Artifact Registry
core_primitives.job: Deterministic inventory of path + explicit durable id where present + kind/schema/status/owner/project/root/privacy/content_hash/source_head/outbound refs.

core_primitives.name: Sparse Explicit Ref Graph
core_primitives.job: Edges only from explicit durable fields/refs in P1: OWNS, DEPENDS_ON, BLOCKS, SUPERSEDES, CONTRADICTS when explicitly declared, CLAIM_FOR, RUN_FOR, RETURN_FOR, CURRENT_FOR, DERIVED_FROM, REFERENCES.

core_primitives.name: Exact + Lexical Retriever
core_primitives.job: Exact ids/codes/paths first; structured filters/tags next; deterministic lexical ranking after that. No semantic service required.

core_primitives.name: Context Compiler
core_primitives.job: Build mandatory closure, retrieve optional candidates, expand explicit graph, enforce freshness/privacy/authority, fit optional evidence to budget and emit Working Set + durable receipt.

query_plan: Q0 resolve source head, actor role, root/project, privacy and authority/current pointers
Q1 load fixed L0 mandatory kernel refs and explicit opportunity/read_scope refs
Q2 build mandatory set M from governing contracts + authority + blockers/incidents/negative knowledge + explicit contradictions relevant to the mission
Q3 exact lookup by durable ids/codes/paths/schema names
Q5 lexical retrieval over path/title/ids/selected text fields
Q6 one-hop or explicitly bounded sparse graph expansion for dependencies/lineage/contradictions
Q7 OPTIONAL semantic fallback only when enabled by benchmark and when earlier stages leave unresolved retrieval need
Q8 deterministic rerank optional set O; authority/freshness/privacy remain hard constraints
Q9 budget prune O only; M cannot be pruned for token cost
Q10 revalidate hashes/source head and emit receipt with stage-level reasons

hard_never_rank_away: source freshness required for the task

staged_implementation.constraints: Define identity precedence, privacy classes, authority extraction, explicit edge mappings, supported parsers, query-plan version and receipt schema before indexing.

staged_implementation.promotion_test: A fresh planner/worker mission recovers every mandatory gold source/constraint and produces durable auditable receipt while reading materially less than repository scan.

staged_implementation.build: Deterministic namespace manifests from artifact metadata/refs/hashes; wire one planner/worker canary to consume compiled Working Set and persist receipt before material work.
staged_implementation.note: Natural-language digest is optional cache only.

staged_implementation.trigger: Only if file-scan/index build/query latency or repository scale becomes a measured bottleneck.
staged_implementation.build: Mirror artifact registry/edges/chunks to derived Postgres tables and use FTS/GIN or equivalent lexical service. Git remains source truth and the DB is rebuildable.

staged_implementation.trigger: Enable only when held-out mission benchmark shows critical semantic misses that deterministic exact/lexical/graph retrieval does not recover, and vector fallback improves retrieval without authority/privacy/freshness regression.
requirements: embedding model + dimensions + provider/version + chunker_version recorded
RRF or explicit fallback strategy documented

staged_implementation.trigger: Only if token/context cost remains a measured bottleneck after structural manifests and retrieval compiler.
staged_implementation.requirements: Summary records source hashes, generator/model/prompt version, coverage pointers and cannot replace mandatory source closure.

artifact_identity_precedence: explicit durable id from recognized schema
recognized compound durable key (for example project_id + opportunity_id/run_id where contract defines it)
normalized repository path fallback for untyped artifacts
identity_and_invalidation_rules.rename_rule: Explicit durable identity survives path rename when schema identity is unchanged; untyped path-derived artifacts use new fallback id plus RENAMED_FROM lineage.
identity_and_invalidation_rules.stale_rule: A projection whose required source/hash/policy key no longer matches cannot be treated as fresh; rebuild or fail closed.

receipt_v2_delta.reason: Proves not merely what was opened but that the retrieval path itself was exercised and auditable.

benchmark_and_promotion_gate.gold_source: Reuse real current Opportunity Queue missions/read_scope as initial benchmark seeds instead of inventing synthetic queries only. Each mission's declared read_scope is a mandatory baseline; Steward/validator may add extra critical refs/forbidden refs as gold annotations.

stop_doing: Stop treating embeddings/vector as a required P1 layer before a benchmark shows semantic misses.
Stop treating generated prose digests as part of the correctness chain; structural manifests first.
Stop representing authority/freshness/privacy as weighted relevance factors.
Stop designing a broad inferred knowledge graph before explicit durable refs have been exhausted.
Stop assuming a DB mirror is necessary for first operational Context Fabric use.
Stop measuring Context Fabric success by presence of architecture/index files; require real Context Receipt and gold-source canary evidence.

unresolved_boundaries: Steward/parent must reconcile this critic return with the independent Context Inventory prototype before changing binding architecture/method heads.
No evidence yet shows the real repository requires embeddings to meet Context Fabric success criteria.
No operational Context Receipt canary has yet proven a real planner/worker consumed a compiler-selected Working Set rather than manually read sources.
Privacy partition policy for future multi-root DB/vector index remains a design/promotion boundary, not solved by final reranking alone.
Natural-language digest generator/model choice remains intentionally unspecified because generated digests are deferred.
negative_knowledge: Hybrid retrieval is a useful option, not a proof that every stage should always execute.
A source hash on a lossy summary proves provenance/freshness, not semantic completeness.
Similarity cannot resolve authority, Current, ownership or privacy.
A deterministic path hash is not the same as durable entity identity when explicit schema identity exists.
Approximate vector recall under filters must be measured against exact search, not assumed.
Context Fabric is DESIGNED_NOT_USED until a real receipt proves a planner/worker consumed its selected Working Set.
